name: Awin
description: Awin affiliate network API for publishers and advertisers: accounts, programmes and commission groups, transactions and transaction queries, offers and vouchers, tracking links, and advertiser, publisher, campaign and creative performance reports. Validating transactions installed switched off. API token.
instructions:
## Awin
This connector works with the **Awin API** at `https://api.awin.com` for both sides of the affiliate network: **publishers** (affiliates) read programmes, commission groups, transactions, transaction queries, offers and performance reports, and build tracking links; **advertisers** read transactions, publishers and performance reports. Validating transactions is possible but installed switched off.

**Setup (about 2 minutes)**
1. Sign in at https://ui.awin.com with a user that has admin access to the publisher or advertiser account (publishers: Account, User Permissions; advertisers: Account, Account Permissions).
2. Open **API Credentials** in the user menu (top right) or go to https://ui.awin.com/awin-api, enter your password and click **Show my API token**.
3. Copy the token into `AWIN_API_TOKEN`.

The token belongs to your user, not to one account: it reaches every publisher and advertiser account your user can open. Advertiser APIs are only available on the Awin Accelerate and Advanced plans. A new or removed account access takes up to 10 minutes to reach the API.

**Where to start**: `awin_list_accounts` lists your accounts. Pass the `accountId` of a publisher account as `publisher_id`, of an advertiser account as `advertiser_id`. Publishers then use `awin_list_programmes` (relationship joined) and `awin_list_publisher_transactions`; advertisers use `awin_list_advertiser_transactions` and `awin_get_publisher_performance_report`.

**Publishers**: programmes with `awin_list_programmes`, `awin_get_programme_details` (EPC, conversion and approval rate, validation days, commission range) and `awin_list_commission_groups`. Sales with `awin_list_publisher_transactions`, `awin_get_publisher_transactions` (by id) and `awin_list_transaction_queries`. Reports: `awin_get_advertiser_performance_report`, `awin_get_publisher_campaign_report`, `awin_get_publisher_creative_report` (all need a `region`). Offers and vouchers: `awin_list_offers`. Links: `awin_generate_tracking_link` (pass `clickref` to recognise the sale later) and `awin_get_link_builder_quota`.

**Advertisers**: `awin_list_advertiser_transactions`, `awin_get_advertiser_transactions`, `awin_get_publisher_performance_report`, `awin_get_advertiser_campaign_report`, `awin_list_publishers` and `awin_list_validation_jobs`.

**Validating transactions (installed switched off)**: `awin_validate_transactions` approves, declines or amends sales. Approving releases commission that the advertiser pays, so turn it on only for workspaces that run validation, and confirm every batch with the user. It answers a job id; `awin_list_validation_jobs` shows the result.

**Dates and limits**: transaction lists take `yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss` (no time zone suffix) plus `timezone`, and at most 31 days per call: split longer periods. Reports take `YYYY-MM-DD`. `commissionStatus` is pending until the advertiser validates, then approved or declined; approved commission is paid out later. Awin allows **20 calls per minute per user**: avoid loops over many accounts or days. Ids are numbers; several ids in one filter are comma-separated.

AWIN_API_TOKEN.label: API token
AWIN_API_TOKEN.help: ui.awin.com, user menu (top right), API Credentials: enter your password and click Show my API token. The token covers every Awin account your user can open.
AWIN_API_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste the API token only, without spaces or the word Bearer.

verifyHints.401: Awin refused the API token. Show it again at https://ui.awin.com/awin-api and paste it without the word Bearer; a token stops working when it is revoked there.
verifyHints.403: Your Awin user has no access to this account, or the account's plan has no API access (advertiser APIs need Accelerate or Advanced). Check the id with awin_list_accounts.
verifyHints.404: Awin found nothing at that id: check the publisher or advertiser id with awin_list_accounts and the transaction or advertiser ids.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Awin allows 20 API calls per minute per user. Wait a minute and try again with fewer calls.

prerequisites: An Awin publisher account, or an advertiser account on the Accelerate or Advanced plan, and a user with admin access to it who can show the API token at ui.awin.com/awin-api. About 2 minutes.

tools.name: awin_list_accounts
tools.description: List the Awin accounts your user can reach with this token: accountId, accountName (programme name for an advertiser, company name for a publisher), accountType (publisher or advertiser) and userRole. Use the accountId as publisher_id or advertiser_id in the other tools. Read-only.

type.description: Only publisher or only advertiser accounts. Default: both.

tools.name: awin_list_programmes
tools.description: Publisher: list advertiser programmes with your relationship to them: id (advertiser id), name, description, displayUrl, clickThroughUrl, logoUrl, currencyCode, primaryRegion, primarySector, linkStatus and validDomains. Filter by relationship and country. Read-only.

publisher_id.description: Your Awin publisher id (accountId of a publisher account in awin_list_accounts).

relationship.description: Only programmes with this relationship (joined = you are a member). Default: all.

country_code.description: Only programmes of this country, ISO alpha-2 (GB, DE, FR...).

include_hidden.description: true: also hidden programmes. Only works without relationship.

tools.name: awin_get_programme_details
tools.description: Publisher: one programme's details and KPIs: programmeInfo (name, description, deeplinkEnabled, membershipStatus, validDomains), kpi (averagePaymentTime, approvalPercentage, epc, conversionRate, validationDays, awinIndex) and commissionRange (min, max, type percentage or amount). Read-only.

publisher_id.description: Your Awin publisher id (accountId of a publisher account in awin_list_accounts).

advertiser_id.description: Advertiser id of the programme (id from awin_list_programmes).

relationship.description: Your relationship to the programme (default joined; use any for a programme you have not joined).

tools.name: awin_list_commission_groups
tools.description: Publisher: the commission groups of one programme you are joined to, with what you earn in each: groupId, groupCode, groupName, type (percentage or fix), percentage, or amount and currency for fix, ratesStart, ratesEnd and conditions. Read-only.

publisher_id.description: Your Awin publisher id (accountId of a publisher account in awin_list_accounts).

effective_date.description: ISO 8601 date-time to read the groups valid at that moment, e.g. 2026-03-15T23:59:59Z. Default: now.

tools.name: awin_list_publisher_transactions
tools.description: Publisher: transactions (sales and leads) in a date range of at most 31 days: id, advertiserId, commissionStatus (pending, approved, declined, deleted), commissionAmount and saleAmount (amount, currency), clickRef, orderRef, transactionDate, validationDate, type, clickDate, customerCountry, commissionSharingPublisherId and custom parameters. Read-only.

publisher_id.description: Your Awin publisher id (accountId of a publisher account in awin_list_accounts).

start_date.description: Start, yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss in the chosen time zone, e.g. 2026-11-01T00:00:00. At most 31 days before end_date.

timezone.description: Time zone of the dates (default UTC).

date_type.description: Which date the range applies to: transaction (default, when the sale happened), validation (when it was approved or declined) or amendment.

status.description: Only transactions in this status. Default: all.

advertiser_ids.description: Only transactions of these advertiser ids, comma-separated.

show_basket_products.description: true: include the basket products of each transaction when the advertiser sends them.

tools.name: awin_get_publisher_transactions
tools.description: Publisher: read transactions by their Awin ids (same fields as awin_list_publisher_transactions). Read-only.

publisher_id.description: Your Awin publisher id (accountId of a publisher account in awin_list_accounts).

timezone.description: Time zone of the dates (default UTC).

show_basket_products.description: true: include the basket products of each transaction when the advertiser sends them.

tools.name: awin_list_transaction_queries
tools.description: Publisher: transaction queries (claims for untracked or wrongly declined sales) in a range of at most 31 days: id, advertiserId, status (pending, approved, declined), clickRef, orderRef, amounts, transaction and enquiry dates. Paged: page_number from 1, up to 500 per page. Read-only.

publisher_id.description: Your Awin publisher id (accountId of a publisher account in awin_list_accounts).

start_date.description: Start, yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss in the chosen time zone, e.g. 2026-11-01T00:00:00. At most 31 days before end_date.

timezone.description: Time zone of the dates (default UTC).

date_type.description: Which date the range applies to (default transactionDate).

statuses.description: Only these statuses, comma-separated: pending, approved, declined.

tools.name: awin_get_advertiser_performance_report
tools.description: Publisher: performance per advertiser for a period and region: advertiserId, advertiserName, impressions, clicks, pending, approved, declined and total counts, sale values and commission (in the region currency). Read-only.

publisher_id.description: Your Awin publisher id (accountId of a publisher account in awin_list_accounts).

region.description: Awin region of the programmes to report on (two letters, e.g. GB, DE, FR, US). Required by Awin; one region per call.

timezone.description: Time zone of the dates (default UTC).

date_type.description: Which date the range applies to: transaction (default) or validation.

tools.name: awin_get_publisher_campaign_report
tools.description: Publisher: clicks, transactions, commission and sale amounts per campaign (the campaign= click parameter) and advertiser, by commission status, optionally per day, month or year. Read-only.

publisher_id.description: Your Awin publisher id (accountId of a publisher account in awin_list_accounts).

region.description: Awin region of the programmes to report on (two letters, e.g. GB, DE, FR, US). Required by Awin; one region per call.

timezone.description: Time zone of the dates (default UTC).

advertiser_ids.description: Only these advertiser ids (from the same region), comma-separated.

interval.description: Sum per day, month or year. Default: one row per campaign for the whole period.

include_numbers_without_campaign.description: true: also clicks and sales without a campaign value.

tools.name: awin_get_publisher_creative_report
tools.description: Publisher: performance per creative (banner, text link, product link) for a period and region: creativeId, creativeName, advertiser, tagName, impressions, clicks, transactions and commission by status. Read-only.

publisher_id.description: Your Awin publisher id (accountId of a publisher account in awin_list_accounts).

region.description: Awin region of the programmes to report on (two letters, e.g. GB, DE, FR, US). Required by Awin; one region per call.

timezone.description: Time zone of the dates (default UTC).

date_type.description: Which date the range applies to: transaction (default) or validation.

tools.name: awin_list_offers
tools.description: Publisher: published offers (promotions and voucher codes): promotionId, type, advertiser, title, description, terms, voucher code, url and urlTracking, startDate, endDate, regions and whether it is exclusive to you. Filter by membership, type, status, region and advertiser. Paged (page from 1, page_size at least 10). Read-only.

publisher_id.description: Your Awin publisher id (accountId of a publisher account in awin_list_accounts).

membership.description: Offers of programmes you joined (default), have not joined, or all.

advertiser_ids.description: Only offers of these advertiser ids.

exclusive_only.description: true: only offers exclusive to you.

updated_since.description: Only offers changed since this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: awin_generate_tracking_link
tools.description: Publisher: build an Awin tracking link (deeplink) to an advertiser page you may promote: url, and shortUrl when shorten is true. Nothing is published; the link counts against your link builder quota (awin_get_link_builder_quota).

publisher_id.description: Your Awin publisher id (accountId of a publisher account in awin_list_accounts).

advertiser_id.description: Advertiser id of a programme you joined.

destination_url.description: Page on the advertiser's site to link to. Default: the programme's landing page. Must be on one of its valid domains.

clickref.description: Your click reference, returned on the transactions (clickRef).

shorten.description: true: also return a short link.

tools.name: awin_get_link_builder_quota
tools.description: Publisher: the link builder quota Awin applies to your publisher account (links you may still generate). Read-only.

publisher_id.description: Your Awin publisher id (accountId of a publisher account in awin_list_accounts).

tools.name: awin_list_advertiser_transactions
tools.description: Advertiser: transactions in a date range of at most 31 days: id, publisherId, commissionStatus, commissionAmount, saleAmount, orderRef, clickRef, transactionDate, validationDate, type, customerCountry, voucherCode, transactionParts by commission group and custom parameters. Read-only.

advertiser_id.description: Your Awin advertiser id (accountId of an advertiser account in awin_list_accounts).

start_date.description: Start, yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss in the chosen time zone, e.g. 2026-11-01T00:00:00. At most 31 days before end_date.

timezone.description: Time zone of the dates (default UTC).

date_type.description: Which date the range applies to: transaction (default, when the sale happened), validation (when it was approved or declined) or amendment.

status.description: Only transactions in this status. Default: all.

publisher_ids.description: Only transactions of these publisher ids, comma-separated.

show_basket_products.description: true: include the basket products of each transaction when the advertiser sends them.

tools.name: awin_get_advertiser_transactions
tools.description: Advertiser: read transactions by their Awin ids (same fields as awin_list_advertiser_transactions). Read-only.

advertiser_id.description: Your Awin advertiser id (accountId of an advertiser account in awin_list_accounts).

timezone.description: Time zone of the dates (default UTC).

show_basket_products.description: true: include the basket products of each transaction when the advertiser sends them.

tools.name: awin_get_publisher_performance_report
tools.description: Advertiser: performance per publisher for a period: publisherId, publisherName, impressions, clicks, pending, approved, declined and total counts, sale values and commission, in your programme currency. Read-only.

advertiser_id.description: Your Awin advertiser id (accountId of an advertiser account in awin_list_accounts).

timezone.description: Time zone of the dates (default UTC).

date_type.description: Which date the range applies to: transaction (default) or validation.

tools.name: awin_get_advertiser_campaign_report
tools.description: Advertiser: clicks, transactions, commission and sale amounts per publisher campaign value, by commission status, optionally per day, month or year. Read-only.

advertiser_id.description: Your Awin advertiser id (accountId of an advertiser account in awin_list_accounts).

timezone.description: Time zone of the dates (default UTC).

interval.description: Sum per day, month or year.

include_numbers_without_campaign.description: true: also clicks and sales without a campaign value.

tools.name: awin_list_publishers
tools.description: Advertiser: the publishers in your programme: id, name, primaryRegion, salesRegions and primaryType (promotion type such as cashback, content, voucher). Read-only.

advertiser_id.description: Your Awin advertiser id (accountId of an advertiser account in awin_list_accounts).

tools.name: awin_list_validation_jobs
tools.description: Advertiser: your transaction validation batch jobs (from awin_validate_transactions) with their status and per-transaction outcome. Read-only.

advertiser_id.description: Your Awin advertiser id (accountId of an advertiser account in awin_list_accounts).

tools.name: awin_validate_transactions
tools.description: Advertiser: approve, decline or amend transactions in one batch. Approving releases the publisher's commission, which your account pays; a declined or amended sale changes what publishers earn. Installed switched off. Each item: action (approve, decline, amend, amendTrackingParameters) and transaction (transactionId, or orderRef with transactionDate and timezone; declineReason or amendReason, saleAmount, currency, transactionParts). Answers a batch job id: read the outcome with awin_list_validation_jobs.

advertiser_id.description: Your Awin advertiser id (accountId of an advertiser account in awin_list_accounts).

action.description: What to do with the transaction.

approve.description: With amend: true approves right after amending.

transaction.description: transactionId (or orderRef, transactionDate and timezone) plus declineReason, amendReason, currency, saleAmount and transactionParts (amount, commissionGroupCode) as the action needs.
